description: This file is a code-behind class for the Razor Page 'EditCatalogItem', handling the logic for editing catalog items in the admin section of the eShopWeb application. It manages form data, authorization, and invoking services for updating catalog items.

classes.name: EditCatalogItemModel
classes.description: Razor Page model for editing catalog items in the admin area, including handling form data, user authorization, and calling application services for updates.

methods.name: EditCatalogItemModel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the view model service dependency.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to populate the page with existing catalog item data.

methods.name: OnPostAsync
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update a catalog item after form submission, with validation and redirection.
